dedupe_keys.name: a global product of 150 m urban building height based on spaceborne lidar

description: A global product of 150-m urban building height based on spaceborne lidar is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Xiao Ma et al. Urban building height, as a fundamental 3D urban structural feature, has far-reaching applications. However, creating readily available datasets of recent urban building heights with fine spatial resolutions and global coverage remains a challenging task. Coverage: global; published in 2024. Formats: GeoTIFF, Image. The data are held in Figshare and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Size stated by the repository: 1512994520 Bytes. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support building-stock, asset and facility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
